requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with an amount, category, date, and description

criteria.must: An employee can submit a claim with amount, category, date, and description
A submitted claim starts in pending status
Submitting a claim without a required field is rejected

requirements.statement: An employee can optionally attach a receipt file to a claim

criteria.must: An employee can attach a receipt file when submitting a claim
An employee can submit a claim with no receipt attached

requirements.statement: An employee can view the status of all their submitted claims

criteria.must: An employee can see a list of their own submitted claims
Each claim in the list shows its status (pending, approved, or rejected)

requirements.statement: An employee can edit or withdraw a claim while it is still pending

criteria.must: An employee can edit a pending claim's details
An employee can withdraw a pending claim
An employee cannot edit or withdraw a claim once it has been approved or rejected

requirements.statement: An employee is notified when their claim is approved or rejected

criteria.must: The employee receives a notification when their claim is approved
The employee receives a notification when their claim is rejected

requirements.statement: A manager can see the pending claims from the employees assigned to them

criteria.must: A manager sees a list of pending claims from their assigned employees
A manager does not see pending claims from employees not assigned to them

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a claim, optionally with a comment

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim
A manager can reject a pending claim
A manager can add a comment when deciding a claim
A manager cannot decide a claim that is not assigned to one of their employees

requirements.statement: Finance can see all approved claims that have not yet been exported

criteria.must: Finance sees a list of approved claims not yet exported
Finance does not see pending or rejected claims in the export-ready list

requirements.statement: Finance can export approved, un-exported claims as a downloadable file

criteria.must: Finance can generate a downloadable export file of approved, un-exported claims

requirements.statement: Claims are marked as exported once included in an export, so they are not exported again

criteria.must: A claim included in an export is marked exported
An exported claim does not appear in a subsequent export-ready list

requirements.statement: An admin can assign each employee to a fixed approving manager

criteria.must: An admin can assign a manager to an employee
A claim submitted by an employee routes to that employee's assigned manager
